results.title: Iran's Araghchi slams chemical weapons claim, accuses Israel of trying to drag US into another war
results.description: TEHRAN — Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi on Wednesday accused Israel of attempting to drag the United States into another war, after its Defense Minister Israel Katz alleged that Tehran was developing chemical weapons. Araghchi said Israel possessed weapons of mass destruction (WMDs) and hid them in pharmaceutical factories.“This warmonger shamelessly accuses Iran of developing and concealing such heinous weapons in pharmaceutical factories. The objective is audacious: to deceive the US into fighting yet another war on its behalf,” he wrote in a statement posted on X.Israel has for years accused Iran of trying to acquire nuclear weapons, but Katz on Tuesday alleged Tehran is building chemical weapons and vowed to stop the Islamic Republic from obtaining them.“Iran is in the process of developing chemical weapons but has not yet reached the capability to attack Israel with them,” said Katz in a statement published by his Likud party on Telegram.“We must not allow this to proceed.”But a key ally of Israeli prime ministerial hopeful Gadi Eisenkot said Wednesday there was no need to attack Iran immediately and questioned the caretaker government’s intentions. Avigdor Liberman said caretaker Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and Defense Minister Israel Katz had a “lust for power” that had driven them “out of their minds.”“The statements about chemical weapons in Iran’s hands are serious, but from an intelligence and operational standpoint, there is no justification for an independent Israeli attack in the immediate term,” Liberman wrote on X.Israeli broadcaster Kan had reported that Israel shared intelligence with the US and Gulf countries alleging that Iran was considering using chemical weapons against them. The report also said Israel had been aware of the alleged program for more than a decade. The Israeli defence minister said the Israeli military and US Central Command were preparing for possible joint operations, adding that the final decision on American involvement would rest with US President Donald Trump. In a strongly worded statement, Araghchi dismissed the allegations against Iran, questioning Israel's credibility on the issue of nuclear, chemical and biological weapons. He accused the Israeli government of refusing to join international conventions prohibiting such weapons while allegedly possessing hundreds of nuclear warheads."The Israeli regime has refused to join any convention banning nuclear, chemical, or biological weapons. It possesses hundreds of nuclear warheads, has attacked seven countries in the region, and occupied territories in three," said Araghchi. The Iranian foreign minister highlighted Tehran's membership of the Nuclear Non-Proliferation Treaty (NPT) and the Organization for the Prohibition of Chemical Weapons (OPCW), arguing that Iran had itself been a victim of chemical weapons during the 1980-88 Iran-Iraq war.
creator: agencies

results.title: Ukraine war briefing: Stop using tear gas on battlefield, dozens of countries tell Russia
results.description: Call comes after chemical weapons watchdog confirms traces of riot-control agent found in Kyiv trench hit with Russian grenade. What we know on day 1,737 Officials from 34 countries and the EU have called on Russia to stop using riot-control gas on the battlefield, after the global chemical weapons watchdog confirmed that Ukraine had found traces of teargas in a trench Kyiv said was hit with a Russian grenade. The joint statement was issued on Wednesday in response to a Ukrainian report circulated to 193 countries as the Organisation for the Prohibition of Chemical Weapons (OPCW) gathered in The Hague this week. Ukraine said it had documented more than 14,000 cases of munitions filled with riot-control agents and toxic chemicals used by Russia on the frontline since 2022. The OPCW said “designated laboratories” approved by the watchdog had “confirmed the presence of a riot-control agent (CS) in samples collected at the scene”. Riot-control agents such as CS, a form of teargas, are banned in warfare. “We call for the immediate cessation of the use of any toxic chemicals and of riot control agents as a method of warfare in Ukraine,” non-proliferation directors from Britain, France, Germany, Japan, New Zealand and the EU, among others, said in a statement. News reports midyear said western intelligence had found that Russian forces were using riot-control agents to drive Ukrainian troops out of trenches and into the open so they could fire on them. Russia has denied using illegal munitions, and has accused Ukraine of doing so. Russian forces attacked Kyiv with ballistic missiles late on Wednesday, striking a shopping centre and two other buildings, mayor Vitali Klitschko said. Two sets of loud explosions were heard. Klitschko said the attack was ongoing, and warned residents to remain in shelters. Three people were wounded, with one in a serious condition. Ukrainian forces struck a major airbase in Russia, damaging five planes used to launch missiles and bombs at Ukraine, the Ukrainian general staff said. Russia did not immediately comment on Wednesday’s claim, which said the Savasleyka airbase in the Nizhny Novgorod region had been hit in Kyiv’s latest long-range attack. Three MiG-31 jets and two Su-34 fighter-bombers were knocked out of operation “for some time”, the general staff said. German chancellor Friedrich Merz accused Russia of “escalating” threats to European security as he defended his government’s plans to bolster defence spending and maintain financial aid to Ukraine. Opposition parties, including on the far right and hard left, have called for an end to aid to Kyiv. “It cannot be said often enough, against the far right as much as the far left: Russia knows exactly what it wants. And Russia wants more than Ukraine,” Merz told the Bundestag. “Russia is escalating in the Baltic region, in Poland, on the Black Sea; Russia is escalating in space, and Russia is by now also escalating massively here in our own country.” US envoy Jared Kushner has warned against a downward spiral in the Ukraine conflict, which he called “a proxy war where Europe is funding and arming Ukraine against Russia”. He told a German podcast that “it won’t take a lot of miscalculation for this thing to escalate massively”. Kushner also appeared to accuse the Europeans of hypocrisy for continuing to buy Russian energy while backing Ukraine. Poland will create a no-fly zone near the Ukrainian border, a deputy defence minister has announced, after several incursions into its airspace, which it blamed on Russia. The no-fly zone is intended to allow Polish forces to quickly identify any Russian military aircraft and shoot them down if necessary. Preparations for Ukrainian drone attacks on Russian utility infrastructure this winter are a top priority for the government, a Russian deputy prime minister said. “This is now the most important question: how we’ll get through the winter, especially given drone attacks, particularly in the border regions,” Marat Khusnullin told lawmakers on Wednesday. Nine more Ukrainian children have been reunited with their families amid the war in Ukraine, bringing the total to 43, under an initiative led by US first lady Melania Trump, the White House and Russia said on Wednesday. There was no immediate comment from Ukrainian authorities. Continue reading...
